number.description:
1-based sequential cell number.
Used to display cell name using {@link #displayName}. Usually set by {@link #fromNbFormat}.

testSpec.description: Holds information about how to test this cell. Stored in {@link #metadata}.testSpec field.

execSpec.description: Holds information about how to run this cell when running using {@link JupyterLab}. Stored in {@link #metadata}.execSpec field.

executionResults.description: Map content type (e.g `text/plain` or `text/html`) to its string representation.

displayData.description: Map content type (e.g `text/plain` or `text/html`) to its string representation.

title:
C3 type type that represents Jupyter cell with code, expected and actual output.
Output data formats is defined at https://nbformat.readthedocs.io/en/latest/format_description.html
name: JupyterNotebook.Cell
